text:
Maya: Kicking off canary for runtime/model combo runtime-2.3.4 / text-gen-v1. Plan: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 30%. Total ramp window ~45m. Start now (10:00 PST). commit abc1234fd. Slices: geo-US-WEST, geo-EU, internal-beta. Smoke checks configured: 3 synthetic prompts, 95th p50 latency, error rate <0.5%. @Ben you ok to be primary pager for first 30m?

Arjun: Ack, I'll wire the dashboard and set temporary alerts for token-latency and generate-errors. Pushing a threshold of 1.2x baseline for p95. I'll post short links to dashboards in 2m.

Priya: I'll run the smoke set now and validate output diffs vs baseline. Two quick checks: hallucination key prompts + structured-output schema. If anything >5% deviation we'll halt.

Ben: I'm on for first 30m. If we need immediate rollback, I can run the rollback command. Also I'll watch tail of error logs and redis caches.

Maya: Rollback command (tested in staging):

```bash
# rollback to previous stable deployment
redwoodctl deploy rollback --env prod --service runtime --to-tag stable-2026-02-17 
```

Maya: Canary policy snippet we applied: 

```yaml
- step: 0.5
  duration: 5m
- step: 2
  duration: 10m
- step: 10
  duration: 15m
- step: 30
  duration: 15m
slices: [geo-US-WEST, geo-EU, internal-beta]
metrics: [p95_latency, error_rate, token_cost]
```

Arjun: Deploy bot just posted: 

deploy-bot: Canary started for runtime-2.3.4 at 0.5% on slice geo-US-WEST. (deploy id: d-20260317-894)

ops-bot: initial smoke checks queued (3 tests)

Priya: smoke run 1/3 passed, smoke run 2/3 minor token truncation on structured prompt — investigating. Not blocking yet, will re-run with the exact seed.

Ben: seeing a ~10ms p95 bump on a small subset in US-WEST, @Arjun is that within our tolerance?

Arjun: 10ms is OK; threshold set to 1.2x baseline. Current is 1.08x. Keeping watch.

Maya: Good. If Priya's structured test regresses on rerun, we'll pause at next step. Who can own a quick rollback if needed? @Ben you said yes. Please confirm you'll execute if Priya flags a fail.

Ben: Confirmed. I'll cut traffic immediately and run rollback if regression persists after one retry.

Priya: rerun smoke 2 -> same failure. It's repeatable locally with the canary image. Logs show mismatch in output schema for prompt id 42. Marking as FAIL.

Maya: OK halting ramp. @Arjun pause the canary, set traffic back to 0.5% and don't advance. Also add a retention snapshot for the failed run.

Arjun: Paused the ramp and pinned traffic at 0.5%. Snapshot created (snap-20260317-d-894). Also set a paging alert for escalation to eng-runtime if error rate creeps above 0.7%.

deploy-bot: Canary paused by operator maya. Traffic pinned to 0.5% on geo-US-WEST.

Ben: Rolling back is standby. Unless Priya wants a hotfix, we keep the pinned canary and run quick bisect on recent changes.

Priya: I'll bisect with the team and try a targeted patch for the schema mapping. ETA 1.5h. Will post root cause and a test matrix.

Maya: Thanks all. Next steps: Priya bisects & posts update, Arjun keeps monitoring, Ben stands by for rollback if needed. If no action in 90m we'll abort this rollout and mark the change as blocked for the next deploy window.

Ben: :thumbsup:

Arjun: dashboards: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/d-20260317-894

Priya: filing a short PR draft for the mapping fix, will request review from @Arjun and @Maya when ready.

Maya: closing the loop here. Post updates as they come. Thanks team :rocket:
